title: Malaysian Grilled Pork Skewers
description: A fusion of flavors from Malaysia, this dish features juicy grilled pork skewers marinated in a fermented soy sauce mixture. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, lime juice, and grill seasoning. Add the pork pieces and marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Thread the marinated pork pieces onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the pork is cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve immediately with grilled pineapple chunks and fresh cilantro leaves. Garnish with Thai chili peppers, if desired.
